adjudication.rationale: In `rest.js.es6`, `basePath(store, type)` now checks `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1`. In JavaScript, `String#replace` with a string argument replaces only the first occurrence, so a type like `some_admin_model` would become `some-admin_model` and would not match an `ADMIN_MODELS` entry written in hyphenated form (e.g. `some-admin-model`). The diff only shows single-underscore types being used (`site_customization`, `embeddable_host`), so no broken behavior is directly verifiable from this PR, but the normalization logic is indeed inconsistent for multi-underscore types and is a concrete edge-case concern in this shared adapter.
